meta.name: firecrawl
meta.description: Search, scrape, and interact with the web via the Firecrawl CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, get data from a website, crawl documentation, download a site, or interact with pages that need clicks or logins. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", or reference external websites. This provides real-time web search with full page content and interact capabilities — beyond what Claude can do natively with built-in tools. Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索、抓取并交互网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网页获取结构化数据或进行实时搜索。
copy.tagline_en: Search, scrape, and interact with web content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract structured data from websites or perform real-time web searches.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可用 Firecrawl 命令联网搜索、抓取网页、批量抓取整站、监测页面变化并交互点击/填表,结果整理为适合 AI 阅读的 Markdown。
howto.when: 当你想搜索资料、抓取某个网址的内容、批量下载整站等联网需求,或说出“fetch this page”这类取网页的说法时触发;本地文件、git 等任务不触发。

say.text: 搜一下最新的 AI 新闻,给我三条摘要。
say.note: 会执行 firecrawl search 并附上抓取的正文。

say.text: 抓取这个页面 https://example.com 的正文。
say.note: 调用 scrape 把页面存成 Markdown。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the Firecrawl CLI to search the web, scrape page content, crawl entire sites, monitor pages for changes, interact through clicks and forms, download sites, and parse local files, returning clean Markdown for LLM contexts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to search the web, scrape a URL's content, bulk-download a site, or says phrases like "fetch this page" / "get the page at https://". Not triggered for local file ops, git, deployments, or code editing.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI news and give me three summaries.
say_en.note: Runs firecrawl search and returns scraped content.

say_en.text: Scrape the content of this page: https://example.com
Monitor https://example.com/pricing for price changes and alert me.
say_en.note: Creates a monitor with webhook or email alerts.
